ledger.claim: POL-NS-01 is drafted conjunctively: the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is chargeable ONLY IF all four limbs hold, so the rider needs to break just one. Limb (a) fails on the face of the record — the trip_record for TRP-00703 carries no driver 'arrived' event at all: arrived_at is null, started_at is null and ended_at is null. There is no arrival event for POL-NS-02 to measure a geofence entry against and no waiting clock that could ever have started.

Limb (d) also fails, and it fails on the record's own words. Limb (d) requires the trip to be terminated BY THE DRIVER with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed. The trip_record shows status CANCELLED_BY_RIDER and cancelled_by RIDER, not a driver termination — and since no in-geofence dwell ever began, no dwell could have elapsed before the 05:34:00 cancellation.

Limb (b) fails on the driver's own telemetry. The trace holds 25 fixes at a 10-second cadence from 05:30:00 to 05:34:00 with 100% coverage and no gaps, and every one of those fixes places the driver 19,176 m to 19,330 m from the pickup pin (mean 19,255 m). For a STANDARD zone the arrival radius is 50 m, and the derived arrival block returns qualifying_fix_count 0 and a longest qualifying run of 0 fixes. Not one fix — let alone the three consecutive fixes at 25 m accuracy or better that POL-NS-02 demands — falls inside the geofence.

That failure is decisive under POL-NS-02. The clause is explicit that where the gps_trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes preceding the cancellation, the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. The rider cancelled at 05:34:00; the trace covers 05:30:00 to 05:34:00 at ~19 km distance throughout, so the whole of the relevant window is covered and it contains zero qualifying fixes.

Limb (c) fails independently on the arithmetic. The minimum dwell for this STANDARD pickup is 300 seconds; the derived arrival block returns a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 0.0 seconds, a driver_qualifying_fix_count of 0 and a shortfall of 300 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the POL-NS-01 minimum, so the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages.

The only qualification POL-NS-06 offers the driver — limb (i), summing separate in-geofence intervals where a kerbside restriction made holding position unlawful — is unavailable here. The traffic_advisory for this pickup road, EV-ADVIS-00703-01, is MISSING: its payload is null and its weight is 0.0. Limb (i) requires an advisory that is present and populated, so the 0.0-second dwell cannot be accumulated upward, and the absence of any advisory is itself citable for the proposition that nothing on this road prevented the driver from reaching the pin.

ledger.claim: POL-NS-03 does not rescue this fee either. That clause governs a driver who genuinely reached the venue but held position at the wrong face of it, and its test is a 400 m ceiling measured from trip_record.pickup. The driver here was 19,176 m away at his closest recorded fix — roughly 48 times the ceiling — so this is not a wrong-entrance case, it is a driver who was never at the venue, and the outcome on the fee is the full refund the GPS alone establishes.

Because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in any of its four limbs, POL-NS-07 cannot be reached: that clause compensates a driver only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it'. POL-NS-06 displaces it and directs that no driver compensation is payable. The SGD 4.80 driver_compensation figure carried in the fare breakdown's derived block has no clause behind it on these facts.

Nothing here warrants escalation, which would hold the fee rather than refund it. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 1, well under the threshold of 4, and 1/110 is under the 0.08 rate limb); rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and rider and driver disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so the same-party repeat limb is not engaged. No admissible artifact contradicts another on arrival, dwell or rider presence, and every artifact that carries a deciding fact is at weight 1.0.

The driver's own counterparty statement confirms the arrival failure from the party best placed to know it: 'I overslept and had not reached the pickup when she cancelled.' That admission is entirely consistent with the telemetry's ~19 km standoff and removes any suggestion that a genuine arrival was made and then mis-recorded.

For completeness the rider does not rely on POL-NS-04: the chat_log for this trip is empty (message_count 0) and the trace carries no rider track, so limbs (a) and (c) of that clause cannot be run. That is immaterial to the outcome, because the refund follows from the driver's side of the arrival test alone — the fee fails under POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 before any question about the rider's own conduct arises.

The driver's own account is corroborated, not contradicted, by the telemetry, and on this record the fee cannot stand: EV-TRIP-00703 records arrived_at as null with the trip cancelled by the rider at 05:34, and EV-GPS-00703's derived arrival facts report 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, with the driver's nearest fix 19,176 m from the pickup pin. POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) therefore fail and, under POL-NS-02, the driver never arrived; the driver does not contest the refund that follows from that arithmetic.

Because EV-TRIP-00703 records arrived_at as null, this driver never tapped 'arrived' at any point, so there is no arrival marker capable of being a false one. POL-NS-05's false-arrival machinery is not engaged on these facts, and no false-arrival event and no limb (ii) referral should be entered against this driver.

There is no anti-farming pattern on this driver's record: EV-DPROF-00703 shows no_show_terminations_30d of 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 termination against 110 completed_trips_30d is 0.9 percent, below the 8 percent rate, so the POL-NS-07 check does not trip and POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged against this driver.

The sum in issue is correctly itemised and admits of no other figure: EV-FARE-00703 carries a single SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and SGD 6.00 is exactly the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule. There is accordingly no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and the only amount in play is that itemised SGD 6.00 line.

EV-CHAT-00703 holds 0 messages and EV-GPS-00703 carries no rider track, so the rider sent no locating or coordinating message during the waiting window. POL-NS-04 limb (a) is not satisfied and the rider cannot be exonerated under that clause; the outcome must rest on the arrival arithmetic of POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-02 alone, and no driver-side coordination failure can be inferred from a chat log that is empty on both sides.

EV-ADVIS-00703-01 is MISSING — no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — so no traffic advisory covers the pickup road in this window. POL-NS-06(i) requires an advisory that is present and populated, and the clause itself provides that asserting the limb against a MISSING artifact triggers POL-NS-09 rather than exonerating anyone; there is therefore no dwell-accumulation route open on this trip.

ruling.explanation:
For both parties: the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee cannot stand and is refunded in full to the rider.

Trip TRP-00703 was a 05:30 STANDARD-zone pickup in a RYDE_PLUS vehicle. The rider cancelled at 05:34:00. Under POL-NS-01 the fee is chargeable only if all four conditions hold, and each fails. (a) The trip record carries no driver 'arrived' event: arrived_at, started_at and ended_at are all null. (b) The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00703) holds 25 fixes at a 10-second cadence from 05:30:00 to 05:34:00 with 100% coverage and no gaps, and every fix places the driver between 19,176 m and 19,330 m from the pickup pin — against a 50 m STANDARD arrival radius — so the derived arrival block returns 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes. (c) The longest qualifying in-geofence run was 0.0 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum. (d) The trip was cancelled by the rider (status CANCELLED_BY_RIDER, cancelled_by RIDER), not terminated by the driver with one of the recognised reason codes.

POL-NS-02 then applies on its own terms: where the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes before cancellation, the driver never arrived and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. POL-NS-06 reaches the same result independently — the effective in-geofence dwell of 0 seconds is 300 seconds short of the required minimum — and the fee is refunded whether or not the rider was present or responded to messages.

The driver's own statement, 'I overslept and had not reached the pickup when she cancelled,' is an admission against his own interest and agrees with the telemetry; it carries no weight multiplier, so it does not enter the confidence cap, but it confirms the ~19 km standoff and removes any suggestion that a real arrival was mis-recorded. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) is not in play: its test is a 400 m ceiling from the pin and the driver was roughly 19 km away.

No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 compensates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not, and POL-NS-06 directs that no compensation is payable on a dwell shortfall; the SGD 4.80 'driver_compensation' figure in the fare breakdown's derived block therefore has no clause behind it on these facts. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip in any event: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against a threshold of 4, and 1 of 110 completed trips is 0.9 percent against the 0.08 rate limb.

POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) is not engaged and produces no referral: with no 'arrived' event at all there is no marker capable of being false. No traffic advisory exists for this pickup road (EV-ADVIS-00703-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0), so the POL-NS-06(i) dwell-accumulation route is unavailable — but it is irrelevant, because the driver never entered the geofence for the dwell to be accumulated. POL-NS-04 is neither needed nor satisfied: the chat log (EV-CHAT-00703) is empty (0 messages) and the trace carries no rider track, so limb (a) cannot be run; the refund follows from the driver's side of the arrival test alone, before any question of the rider's own conduct arises.

No escalation arises under POL-NS-09: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, the same-party repeat limb is not engaged (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0), no abuse pattern is shown, and every artifact carrying a deciding fact is at full weight 1.0.

The only amount in issue is the single SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line in EV-FARE-00703 (payment status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). That figure is exactly the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00) under the fee_schedule resolution rule, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and no booking or platform fee is charged on a cancelled trip. The whole of that line — SGD 6.00 — is refunded.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
